fields.author: None

fields.title: Goblin Slayer Side Story Year One
fields.author: None

fields.title: Solo Leveling
fields.description: In a world where hunters must battle deadly monsters to protect humanity, Sung Jin-Woo, a low-ranking hunter, gains a mysterious system that allows him to level up without limits.
fields.author: None

fields.title: Tower of God
fields.description: Reach the top, and everything will be yours. At the top of the tower exists everything in this world, and all of it can be yours. You can become a god.
fields.author: None

fields.title: One Piece
fields.description: Monkey D. Luffy refuses to let anyone or anything stand in the way of his quest to become the king of all pirates. With a course charted for the treacherous waters of the Grand Line and beyond, this is one captain who will never give up until he's claimed the greatest treasure on Earth—the Legendary One Piece!
fields.author: None

fields.title: The King's Avatar
fields.description: In the online game Glory, Ye Xiu is regarded as a textbook and a top-tier pro-player. However, due to a series of circumstances, he was forcibly expelled from his professional team. After leaving the pro scene, he finds work as an Internet Cafe manager. When Glory launches its tenth server, he throws himself into the game once more.
fields.author: None

fields.title: Naruto
fields.description: Naruto Uzumaki is a young ninja who seeks recognition from his peers and dreams of becoming the Hokage, the leader of his village.
fields.author: None

fields.title: Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint
fields.description: Dokja was an average office worker whose sole interest was reading his favorite web novel 'Three Ways to Survive the Apocalypse.' But when the novel suddenly becomes reality, he is the only person who knows how the world will end.
fields.author: None

fields.title: The Beginning After The End
fields.description: King Grey has unrivaled strength, wealth, and prestige in a world governed by martial ability. However, solitude lingers closely behind those with great power. Reincarnated into a new world filled with magic and monsters, the king has a second chance to relive his life.
fields.author: None

fields.title: Martial Peak
fields.description: The journey to the martial peak is a lonely, solitary and long one. In the face of adversity, you must survive and remain unyielding. Yang Kai, an ordinary disciple of the High Heaven Pavilion, obtains a black book, setting him on the path to the pinnacle of the martial world.
fields.author: None

fields.title: Tales of Demons and Gods
fields.description: Nie Li, the strongest Demon Spiritist in his past life, stood at the pinnacle of the martial world. However, he lost his life during the battle with the Sage Emperor and the six deity-ranked beasts. His soul was then reborn back in time to when he was 13 years old.
fields.author: None

fields.title: Berserk
fields.description: Guts, a former mercenary now known as the 'Black Swordsman,' is out for revenge. After a tumultuous childhood, he finally finds someone he respects and believes he can trust, only to have everything fall apart when this person takes away everything important to Guts for the purpose of fulfilling his own desires.
fields.author: None

fields.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
fields.description: Yuji Itadori is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a classmate who has been attacked by curses, he eats the finger of Ryomen Sukuna, taking the curse into his own soul.
fields.author: None
